Deep-copy all input data. `collection_names()` returns names in ascending order. `fields(name)` returns the first row's field names in insertion order, or an empty tuple for an empty collection. `select(name, filters=None)` returns rows whose values equal every entry in the filter mapping; `None` means no filters. All returned rows must be deep copies and must not expose internal nested values.

`ResidentCatalog.residents_in_zone(zone)` selects from `residents` using field `zone`. `WorkerCatalog.workers_with_role(role)` selects from `workers` using field `role`. Both arguments must be strings; empty strings are permitted and matched normally.

import copy
import unittest

from solution import MemoryCatalog, ResidentCatalog, WorkerCatalog


class MemoryCatalogTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_names_fields_selection_and_empty_collection(self):
        source = {
            "zeta": [],
            "people": [
                {"name": "Ana", "zone": "east", "age": 30},
                {"name": "Bo", "zone": "west", "age": 30},
                {"name": "Cy", "zone": "east", "age": 40},
            ],
        }
        catalog = MemoryCatalog(source)
        self.assertEqual(catalog.collection_names(), ["people", "zeta"])
        self.assertEqual(catalog.fields("people"), ("name", "zone", "age"))
        self.assertEqual(catalog.fields("zeta"), ())
        self.assertEqual(catalog.select("people", {"zone": "east", "age": 30}), [
            {"name": "Ana", "zone": "east", "age": 30}
        ])
        self.assertEqual(catalog.select("people", {}), source["people"])
        self.assertEqual(catalog.select("zeta"), [])

    def test_input_and_output_are_deep_copied(self):
        nested = {"labels": ["initial"]}
        source = {"items": [{"id": 1, "data": nested}]}
        original = copy.deepcopy(source)
        catalog = MemoryCatalog(source)
        source["items"][0]["data"]["labels"].append("changed")
        source["items"].append({"id": 2})
        self.assertEqual(catalog.select("items"), original["items"])
        first = catalog.select("items")
        second = catalog.select("items")
        self.assertIsNot(first, second)
        self.assertIsNot(first[0], second[0])
        self.assertIsNot(first[0]["data"], second[0]["data"])
        first[0]["data"]["labels"].append("leak")
        self.assertEqual(catalog.select("items"), original["items"])

    def test_filter_values_use_equality(self):
        catalog = MemoryCatalog({"rows": [{"v": [1, 2]}, {"v": [2, 3]}]})
        filters = {"v": [1, 2]}
        before = copy.deepcopy(filters)
        self.assertEqual(catalog.select("rows", filters), [{"v": [1, 2]}])
        self.assertEqual(filters, before)

    def test_unknown_collections(self):
        catalog = MemoryCatalog({"known": []})
        with self.assertRaises(KeyError):
            catalog.fields("missing")
        with self.assertRaises(KeyError):
            catalog.select("missing")

    def test_malformed_construction_and_queries(self):
        invalid_collections = [
            None,
            [],
            {"": []},
            {1: []},
            {"x": 3},
            {"x": [1]},
            {"x": [{1: "bad"}]},
        ]
        for value in invalid_collections:
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                with self.assertRaises((TypeError, ValueError)):
                    MemoryCatalog(value)
        catalog = MemoryCatalog({"x": [{"a": 1}]})
        for name in (None, 1, ""):
            with self.subTest(name=name):
                with self.assertRaises((TypeError, ValueError, KeyError)):
                    catalog.select(name)
        for filters in ([], "a=1", {1: 1}):
            with self.subTest(filters=filters):
                with self.assertRaises((TypeError, ValueError)):
                    catalog.select("x", filters)

    def test_specialized_catalogs(self):
        residents = ResidentCatalog({"residents": [
            {"name": "A", "zone": ""}, {"name": "B", "zone": "north"}
        ]})
        workers = WorkerCatalog({"workers": [
            {"name": "C", "role": "dev"}, {"name": "D", "role": ""}
        ]})
        self.assertEqual(residents.residents_in_zone(""), [{"name": "A", "zone": ""}])
        self.assertEqual(workers.workers_with_role("dev"), [{"name": "C", "role": "dev"}])
        for bad in (None, 1, True):
            with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                residents.residents_in_zone(bad)
            with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                workers.workers_with_role(bad)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
